ai.summary: Delhi Police served a notice to Mamata Banerjee, former West Bengal chief minister, to record a statement in a 2013 case involving a confrontation with police during a Trinamool Congress protest in Delhi.

facts.claim: Delhi Police has served a notice to former West Bengal chief minister Minister Mamata Banerjee
facts.quote: Delhi Police has served a notice to former West Bengal chief minister Minister Mamata Banerjee, asking her to record her statement in a 2013 case linked to a confrontation with police during a Trinamool Congress protest in the national capital, police sources said on Monday.

facts.claim: Banerjee has been issued the notice in her capacity as a witness in the case, and not as an accused
facts.quote: Banerjee has been issued the notice in her capacity as a witness in the case, and not as an accused, the sources clarified.

facts.claim: The case pertains to an incident in April 2013, when Banerjee, accompanied by a delegation of Trinamool ministers and MPs, reached Delhi to protest against the alleged assault on then-Bengal finance minister Amit Mitra by members of the Students’ Federation of India (SFI).
facts.quote: The case pertains to an incident in April 2013, when Banerjee, accompanied by a delegation of Trinamool ministers and MPs, reached Delhi to protest against the alleged assault on then-Bengal finance minister Amit Mitra by members of the Students’ Federation of India (SFI).

facts.claim: A confrontation reportedly broke out between Banerjee and Delhi Police personnel after the latter attempted to restrict the movement of the delegation, citing security concerns and prohibitory orders.
facts.quote: A confrontation reportedly broke out between Banerjee and Delhi Police personnel after the latter attempted to restrict the movement of the delegation, citing security concerns and prohibitory orders.

facts.claim: Banerjee reportedly told police that she was a “Lok Policy Representative (LIP)” and not a VIP, saying she came to the national capital to fight for people’s rights.
facts.quote: Banerjee reportedly told police that she was a “Lok Policy Representative (LIP)” and not a VIP, saying she came to the national capital to fight for people’s rights.

facts.claim: The notice has been issued to record her statement as a witness in the investigation, the sources said.
facts.quote: The notice has been issued to record her statement as a witness in the investigation, the sources said.
